answer: Strongest sybil defense: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Each task pulls a small random quorum from wallets with aged identity, slashable stake, and clean dispute history; a quiet lagoon of fresh keys is never sampled. To sway a verdict an attacker must grow many real-looking members slowly, at risk, since collusion burns stake. The delta between minting cheap keys and corrupting a quorum grows with its size, so forgery costs more than fraud earns, and plumes of new voters enter no pool
